_description: POST /api/agents/prompt — Creates a declarative (prompt) agent grounded on an Azure AI Search index that indexes content from an Azure Storage Account.
instructions: You are a knowledgeable assistant. Use the provided knowledge base to answer questions accurately. Cite the relevant document when possible.
description: Agent grounded on blob-storage content via Azure AI Search.

searchTools._comment: connectionName must match an Azure AI Search connection visible via GET /api/connections?type=AzureAISearch. The search index should be configured to ingest documents from your Azure Storage Account.
